[[Hulking Volatile Ooze]]s behave like their smaller counterpart [[Volatile Ooze]]. However, when they die, a variety of other oozes will appear.

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Ooze Pit}}

==Skills==
*{{monster skill icon|Unstable Ooze Explosion}}

==Notes==
*Be cautious of the oozes [[spawn]]ing from the explosion.
*The oozes spawned from these can individually be [[pull]]ed away from the originating [[mob]].
